name: Lindshammar - Ramkvilla
description: Lindshammar to Ramkvilla. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official current HÖ9 is Lindshammar-Ramkvilla, 20.4 km. OSM splits this corridor into legacy Lindshammar-Lökarydssjön and Lökarydssjön-Ramkvilla-Torp relations with older endpoints.
Official HÖ9 narrative says Lökaryd has the rest area, but linked/API coordinate-backed facility records are named Sars.

Official lane reports Avstickare Boskvarnasjön API length 0.2 km, while description says about 350 m. HÖ9 API neighbor includes unpublished/null badplats-like id 128100, while the public bathing-place page uses site id 51794.
Naturkartan lists HÖ9 under Jönköpings län/Vetlanda, but the GPX starts in Uppvidinge/Kronoberg and ends in Vetlanda/Jönköping.
Route-app distances/labels vary: Wikiloc 21.84 km, Komoot 19.481/19.5 km, Komoot legacy Höglandsleden E4/Smålandsleden 14 labels, while official HÖ9 is 20.4 km.
Facilities lane found OSM Sunday opening status conflicted with ICA official Sunday closed information.

facilities.name: Lindshammar ledentré HÖ8/HÖ9
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ8/HÖ9 entrance. HÖ8 and HÖ9 meet here, and Vildmarksleden connects nearby. Official text says restaurant and B&B are in Lindshammar. Shared endpoint with HÖ8. No confirmed public water or official parking.

facilities.name: Sergel B+B / Café Sergel
facilities.description: Commercial cafe/food/lodging context at Lindshammar near the HÖ9 start. Commercial and seasonal. Website says closed for season and welcome back 2026. Water only commercial/when open.

facilities.name: Avstickare Boskvarnasjön
facilities.description: Unmarked side spur from HÖ9 toward Boskvarnasjön parking, bathing place and toilet. API length says 0.2 km while description says about 350 m. Model as side/access metadata, not main HÖ9 geometry.

facilities.name: Sars / Lökaryd rest area shelter
facilities.description: Official four-person shelter at the practical Lökaryd/Sars rest-area cluster. Source text says there is a fireplace, picnic table, dry toilet and waste bin nearby; bring own firewood because supply is not guaranteed. Official stage text calls the rest area Lökaryd, while coordinate-backed POIs are named Sars. No potable water.

facilities.name: Dass, Höglandsleden Sars
facilities.description: Official dry toilet at the Sars/Lökaryd rest-area cluster. Facilities lane found a third-party shelter source suggesting toilet condition may be poor; verify current condition before high-confidence facility display.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Höglandsleden Sars
facilities.description: Official fireplace at Sars/Lökaryd. Naturkartan facts say cement ring, shelter, toilet, table, seating and waste bin are present; near-water, grate and charcoal are not. No water; firewood not guaranteed. Fire-ban/current fire-risk status must be checked.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Höglandsleden Kladdaberg
facilities.description: Official three-person shelter in a protected forest setting near large boulders. Has a fireplace; users should bring their own firewood and extinguish carefully. No confirmed toilet, waste or water.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Höglandsleden Kladdaberg
facilities.description: Official fireplace at Kladdaberg. Naturkartan facts indicate shelter yes, but no toilet, table, seating, waste bin, nearby water, grate or charcoal. No water; firewood not guaranteed. Could be merged with the Kladdaberg shelter during normalization.

facilities.name: ICA Nära Puttes Lanthandel
facilities.description: Grocery/service in Ramkvilla near the HÖ9 end. Opening-hour contradiction: OSM had Sunday open, ICA official page says Sunday closed. Use ICA as authoritative. Water only commercial/when open.

facilities.name: Ramkvilla ledentré HÖ9/HÖ10
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ9/HÖ10 entrance at Ramkvilla sports ground/idrottsplatsen, with plenty of parking and grocery store nearby. Shared HÖ9/HÖ10 endpoint. No public drinking-water claim.

facilities.name: Ramkvilla Camping
facilities.description: Commercial camping/ställplats near the HÖ9 end with showers, toilets, camping kitchen, laundry, latrine disposal, cafe/kiosk and grill place in source context. Water likely available when open/serviced, but not confirmed as public drinking water outside operations.

facilities.name: Klockesjöbadet / Klockesjöns badplats
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place near the Ramkvilla endpoint with jetty/jump tower, changing room, seating and waste bin. No toilet/table/grill per official lane/facilities sources. Bathing water is not drinking water. HaV latest sample reported by official lane: 2025-07-08 tjänligt, no bloom.
